title: 中国电力产能扩张提速 电网消纳与结构再平衡成关键
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Imagine building a country's power capacity in a single year.
segments.zh: 想象一下，一年内建成一个国家的电力产能。

segments.en: That's essentially what China did in 2025.
segments.zh: 这基本上就是中国在2025年所做的。

segments.en: It added enough power to match India's entire electricity system more than 500 gigawatts in just 12 months.
segments.zh: 它新增的电力足以匹配印度整个电力系统，超过500吉瓦，仅用12个月。

segments.en: This kind of growth and rapid development is really unprecedented.
segments.zh: 这种增长和快速发展确实是前所未有的。

segments.en: With the target of net zero by 2060, and with energy security as a national priority, Beijing is unleashing the biggest renewable energy buildouts
segments.zh: 以2060年净零为目标，并将能源安全作为国家优先事项，北京正在释放史上最大的可再生能源建设。

segments.en: the world has ever seen. China has showed that it can build renewable power capacity at scale.
segments.zh: 这是世界前所未见的。中国已表明它能大规模建设可再生能源产能。

segments.en: Now it needs the show that it can use it.
segments.zh: 现在它需要证明自己能使用它。

segments.en: Because right now, China is producing too much.
segments.zh: 因为目前，中国生产得太多了。

segments.en: In just the first half of 2026, some estimates suggest the amount of wind and solar energy wasted
segments.zh: 仅在2026年上半年，一些估计表明浪费的风能和太阳能

segments.en: could have powered all of France.
And yet China is betting on AI, robotics and advanced manufacturing to drive its next phase of economic growth,
segments.zh: 然而中国正押注人工智能、机器人和先进制造来推动下一阶段经济增长，

segments.en: all of which require vast amounts of power.
So that wants to create this layer of almost infinite, cheap, clean electricity that its industries can tap into.
segments.zh: 因此希望打造近乎无限、廉价、清洁的电力层，供各行业使用。

segments.en: The question is whether it can successfully rewire the grid to utilize all this energy without overloading the system.
segments.zh: 问题在于能否成功改造电网，利用所有这些能源而不使系统过载。
